text:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — launching a 'Plugin Playground' developer workshop next Tues. Need: launch post, 3-step quickstart tutorial, 5-min demo vid, benchmark narrative + a simple signup flow. Lean community-first, low-friction onboarding. Thoughts?
AJ Park: Love it. Audience: devs trying Redwood Private + plugin hooks. We should highlight latency/cost wins in the benchmark.
Samir Patel: I can draft quickstart + demo script. Can we scope the plugin example to a Slack bot + embeddings? Simple, cross-platform.
Ben O'Neill: I'll take the launch post headline + TL;DR. Suggest: 'Build a plugin in 30 minutes — Plugin Playground' as working headline. :rocket:
Maria Chen: Assigning: @Samir quickstart + demo. @Ben post + social copy. @AJ benchmark narrative and perf notes. Also need a one-click signup flow for community signups — @prod-bot can you create a tracking route?
prod-bot: New ticket created: ENG-MKT-4823 — 'plugin-playground signup route'. Assignee: growth-ops. ETA: 2025-04-04
AJ Park: For benchmark, target 2 datasets: short-chat (latency-focused) and embeddings-index (throughput). We'll include cost/sample and call out batching tradeoffs. Need sample configs: batch_size, quantization. Samir, can you include expected token counts in demo?
Samir Patel: Yes. Demo will use ~150 tokens prompt; embeddings flow ~512 tokens/search. I'll add example curl + SDK snippet: ```bash
curl -XPOST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rw-ggml-7b","prompt":"Hello plugin"}'
```
Ben O'Neill: Social plan: 1 launch blog + 2 microthreads (technical + use-case). Also a 60s reel from demo. I'll do headers and short tweet drafts. Need a hero screenshot from the demo — Samir can you export?
Maria Chen: Timeline: Drafts by EOD Thu (2012345690). Review Fri morning, publish Tue dawn. Signups open Mon. Is that realistic?
AJ Park: Tight but doable. I'll prioritize benchmark drafts + summary table. Can we use the console latency dashboard screenshot for visual?
Samir Patel: Yep I'll export a short gif for the hero. Also I'll push an example repo to github.com/redwood/plugin-playground with README.
Ben O'Neill: Can we add a small "migration path" note for Dedicated customers? They need certs + VPC steps.
Maria Chen: Good call. Add a one-paragraph enterprise note in the launch post and a link to the Dedicated checklist. Action items recap: Samir (quickstart, demo, gif, example repo), AJ (benchmarks + perf table + console screenshot), Ben (post + social + enterprise note), prod-bot (signup route). I'll collate and draft the main body.
AJ Park: Also suggest a small A/B: 'latency-first' vs 'cost-first' headline variants. Run quick experiments on open beta cohort.
Samir Patel: I'll seed 50 test signups and share initial metrics to the thread.
Ben O'Neill: I'll draft two headlines and 3 tweet variants and drop in #marketing-drafts.
Maria Chen: Thanks team. Ping me if blockers. :pray:
